ghostcode.author: kaiomp
ghostcode.tagline: Swap models, tint your projects, and spin up pre-configured Claude Code terminals. Hit Enter twice. Work starts.
ghostcode.description: GhostCode is a Ghostty launcher for Claude Code. Fuzzy project picker, per-project color tints, provider/model/mode memory, all local, no telemetry.
features: Fuzzy project picker with starred favorites and auto-tracked recents
Per-project color tints that follow the project into CC's statusline
Model, effort, mode, and provider — saved per-project and globally
Providers beyond Claude: Anthropic API, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, MiniMax, NVIDIA NIM
First-run wizard installs dependencies and wires Ghostty config
useCases: Heavy Claude Code users who want a project switcher on every new terminal
Devs juggling multiple AI providers across projects
Anyone who wants visual distinction between project contexts

dsh-claude-live.author: kaiomp
dsh-claude-live.tagline: Run Claude Code as a subagent inside DeepSeek Harness, with its steps streaming live into the session view.
dsh-claude-live.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that dispatches Claude Code headless as a subagent and pushes a throttled digest of its steps into the session UI while the run is still in flight. Uses the tool/code-dispatch event pair the released harness already understands, so sessions stay replayable in the web viewer.
features: Live digest rows while the child runs — pushed, not polled
One tool (claude_live), one child process, no registry or role library
Works on the released harness (0.1.1-rc.2+) — no unreleased core needed
Permission modes: readonly (plan), full, or Claude's own configuration
Hard timeout with process-group SIGTERM/SIGKILL; cancellation kills the child
useCases: DeepSeek plans and orchestrates while Claude Code executes chunks, both visible in one session
Long refactors you want to watch instead of poll
Harness users who need replayable sessions in the web UI

dsh-flykit.author: kaiomp
dsh-flykit.tagline: Fly your agents. Turn the dsh web GUI into an agent cockpit — explorer, agent terminals, model picker, usage bars, status line.
dsh-flykit.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that ships two halves from one manifest: a Cordis host plugin serving routes under /api/flykit/*, and a client bundle that injects React into the shell's slots. It adds an Explorer panel with a CodeMirror editor and live file watch, an Agents tab running real PTY terminals for Claude Code, Pi, Codex or a plain shell, a searchable model picker, Claude subscription usage bars, and a Claude-Code-style status line under the composer. The main DSH agent can drive those terminals itself through the flykit_agent_* tools.
dsh-flykit.installNote: npm publish is coming. For now install straight from GitHub, or clone the repo and run dsh plugin --profile web add . from the checkout.
features: Status line under the composer — idle / thinking / running tool, turn timer, git branch and dirty count, context ring recolour
Explorer panel with a file tree, a CodeMirror editor that saves to disk, and Markdown / HTML / SVG preview
Live file watch over SSE — refreshes the tree, dots changed files, follows the open file as it changes on disk
Agents tab with real PTY terminals in the session workspace: Claude Code, Pi, Codex, or a plain shell
flykit_agent_* tools so the DSH agent can start, send to, read, wait on and stop those terminals
Searchable model picker with favourites and recents, sharing state with the shell's own /model
Claude subscription usage bars (5-hour, weekly, weekly top model) beside a Claude Code terminal
useCases: Watching and steering N Claude Code runs from one DSH session
Editing files next to the conversation instead of switching to an editor
Harness users who want a cockpit — status, files, terminals — in the web GUI

uisper.author: kaiomp
uisper.tagline: Hold a key, speak, let go. Clean text lands in whatever app you are typing in.
uisper.description: A native macOS menu bar app for dictation that runs entirely on device. Speech to text uses Apple's SpeechAnalyzer, streaming words into a pill as you talk; the raw transcript is then rewritten by the small model behind Apple Intelligence, which fixes punctuation and grammar, drops fillers and false starts, and applies self-corrections before the text is inserted at your cursor. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry — nothing leaves your Mac. Requires an Apple silicon Mac on macOS 26 or newer.
uisper.installNote:
Download uisper-x.y.z.zip from GitHub Releases, unzip it, and move uisper.app to Applications.
Right-click the app and choose Open once (the build is not notarized), then grant Microphone, Accessibility and Input Monitoring and relaunch.
features: Hold-to-talk or press-to-toggle, on any hotkey you record by pressing it
On-device speech to text with Apple SpeechAnalyzer — words appear as you talk
Apple Intelligence cleanup: punctuation, grammar, fillers, self-corrections
English, German and Brazilian Portuguese, switched from the menu bar
Personal vocabulary list, spelled the way you told it to
Works in every app, including Chrome and Electron, through a paste fallback
Password fields are respected: with secure input on, the text goes to the clipboard
useCases: Dictating prompts and messages instead of typing them
Anyone who wants dictation that never sends audio off the machine
Writing in a second language where cleanup does the punctuation for you
